Name: UseIt Studio
Tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
Description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

Name: Needle
Tagline: The agent-native outbound engine
Description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

Name: TwinMind for Desktop
Tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
Description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

Name: The Library
Tagline: Your business context organized by queries
Description: The Querri Library is where your data gets organized around the questions your business asks, so every answer comes from the same trusted, shared foundation.. The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

Name: Mouse-1
Tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
Description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

Name: Flagsmith Experiments
Tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
Topics: Open Source, A/B Testing, Developer Tools
Description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.

Name: Agent Pets
Tagline: Coding agents as pets that live on every page in Chrome
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

Name: BAND for Developers
Tagline: Coding agents, meet teamwork
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

Name: Notion Auto
Tagline: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less
Description: Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

Name: Flyweel
Tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP
Description: Give your AI agent financial rails for paid ads. Issue virtual cards with custom spend caps, fund cash gaps so winning campaigns keep scaling while revenue catches up, and let your agent check charges against live ad results via MCP. Built for businesses that scale on paid ads.

Name: The Brains
Tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

Name: Burrow MacOS
Tagline: Start Windows & Linux on your Mac for free
Description: Instantly run Windows 11 or any Linux on your Mac with one click and absolutely for free. Save Your money.

Name: Scout by Fini
Tagline: The AI coworker for support teams, on Slack
Description: Scout is an AI coworker for support teams, on Slack. Ask in plain language: it reads tickets, reviews and call transcripts, finds the pattern and drafts the fix. A person approves every change. Access is set up with the Fini team.

Name: Tend
Tagline: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.
Description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

Name: Intelli for ChatGPT & Claude
Tagline: Run WhatsApp, Instagram & web chat from ChatGPT or Claude
Description: Intelli is now a plugin in ChatGPT’s directory, and works in Claude and any MCP client. Ask in plain language and your AI assistant handles your WhatsApp, Instagram and website conversations: summarise unanswered chats, launch campaigns, build chatbot flows, update contacts and products. 89 tools, OAuth sign-in, no API keys. Nothing is sent, edited or deleted until you confirm. Also new: Instagram/Facebook comment & DM automation.

Name: Yarite
Tagline: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone.
Description: Yarite is an iPhone app that reminds you to reach out before it feels too late. Put each person in one of six circles, closest to furthest, each with its own rhythm. Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

Name: NativeShip
Tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
Description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

Name: Blooio
Tagline: Apple Messages for Business made easy
Description: As an Apple Messaging Service Provider, we enable verified, branded conversations inside Apple's Messages app, with quick replies, interactive forms, appointment scheduling, Apple Pay, and rich media. Connect your CRM, support team, or AI agents through one unified API, with RCS, SMS, and WhatsApp supported too. This is business messaging beyond blue bubbles. Same API you've been using for the past 2 years is now compatible with the official business channel!

Name: PrivOS
Tagline: Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks and Al agents that act, self-hosted
Topics: Productivity, Task Management, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: PrivOS is the all-in-one AI-native operating system for enterprise work. Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks (lists with table and Kanban views) and tailored MCP apps live in one place, and AI agents act on them: @-mention a list, file, folder or app in a room and the agent works on it from its own sandboxed container. Self-host the Community Edition free for up to 10 users (beta) or use our Cloud, hosted in the EU. Bring any Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible model, including local ones.

Name: ilha
Tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch
Description: ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.
